name: peerforum
description: PFP v2 - a modern, serverless P2P forum (clean TypeScript/libp2p rewrite of PeerForum)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm -w @pforum/web run typecheck && npm -w @pforum/desktop run typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: npm -w @pforum/web run build && npm -w @pforum/desktop run build:main && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:web: npm -w @pforum/web run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=web
